displayPattern: 7-segment display on a *R9S96, *D9S96 or *R9S92 single-stage furnace in IOG-2037B (Goodman GR9S96, GD9S96 and GR9S92, and the Amana models in that same guide): EbU
meaning: Blower current too high during pre-purge: the main blower is above the value the control expected, and the furnace goes to hard lockout.
causes: Loose wiring to or from the blower motor
Line wires to the control and the main blower motor reversed at the control
diySteps: Write down EbU. This is the high-current blower fault, not EbL
Technician: verify wiring connections to and from the motor are not loose
Technician: verify the line wires to the control and the main blower motor are not reversed at the control
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician. Reversed line wiring at the control is not a homeowner check.
